name: Shop Stride: Grocery Route
subtitle: Grocery list in walking order
promotionalText: Type your list, pick your store, and walk it in the shortest order. Cold stuff last.
description:
Shop Stride turns your grocery list into the shortest walk through the store.

Type what you need, pick your store, and Shop Stride sorts your list by aisle and draws your route on a store map. Frozen and dairy come last so they stay cold.

- Grocery list sorted in walking order, grouped by aisle and department
- Store map with your route and numbered stops
- Aisles shared by other shoppers at the same store, and remembered for you
- Read aisles from screenshots of a store's own app
- 30 weeknight recipes with filters; add a recipe's ingredients in one tap
- Add your own recipes from a photo, a link or pasted text
- Community recipes: browse breakfast, dinner, desserts and more from other shoppers, save the ones you like and share your own
- Sign in with Apple, Google or email to keep your recipes on every phone
- Find supported stores near you on a map and see which one is best for your list
- No ads. Your grocery list stays on your phone, and no account is needed to shop.

Made by Weltzcraft Studios.
reviewNotes:
No account is needed for the grocery list. Type items on the List tab (for example milk, bread, eggs), tap the store card to choose a store (Stores tab: tap Shop here, or By ZIP and enter a US ZIP code such as 53703, or choose Other and type any name), then tap Start shopping to see the route and store map. Tap any item to set its aisle.

Accounts (optional): Recipes tab > person icon. Sign in with Apple, Google, or email (a 6-digit code is emailed). Account screen has Sign out and Delete account. Signed-in recipes sync across phones.

Community (user-generated recipes): Recipes tab > Community. Anyone can browse; sharing needs an account and agreeing to the community rules shown before posting. A word filter blocks offensive text. On any shared recipe, the ... button offers Report recipe and Block author; 3 reports hide a recipe automatically and the developer reviews reports daily. Contact: shopstride@weltzcraft.com (Contact us at the bottom of the List tab).
